rows.observation: The target adds a clause that is not in the source: 「每回合使非固定冷却技能额外减少 1 回合冷却」. The source at tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/other.lua:437 (source unpinned) only says long_desc raises damage by eff.damage and resistances by eff.resist; the frozen snippet shows no cooldown effect. It also adds 「全部」 to damage and resistance. Unless the effect code shows this cooldown mechanic, remove the clause and match the source.
rows.conclusion: 宿主补查 envelope 外的 on_timeout：other.lua MECHARACHNID_PILOTING_BUFF 每回合对非 fixed_cooldown 技能冷却减 1，译文补述贴合实现；“全部”对应 resists all / inc_damage all，亦与实现一致。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: The source says 'every third hit always crits.' and line 1084 has o.charge = o.charge + 1, so it counts hits and repeats. 「第三下攻击必定暴击」 drops 'every', which reads as a one-time third attack. It should say something like 「每第三次命中必定暴击」. The source also says 'hit' (on-hit), not 'attack'.
rows.conclusion: 同 surface 裁决：Golden Gun（金枪）按命中计数循环，every third hit 为每第三次命中。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: The source asks 'Is it the tentalizing notion of eternal life?', meaning the pull may come from the tempting idea of eternal life. The target 「这，就是永恒生命的具象化吗？」 changes this to 'is this the embodiment of eternal life' and loses both 'tantalizing' and 'notion'. Suggested fix: 「是永生那诱人的念想吗？」.
rows.conclusion: 同 surface 裁决：tantalizing notion of eternal life 是诱人的念头，非“具象化”。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: The source says 'The system can only trigger once every %d turns.', which is a cooldown limit (t.getCD, line 202). The target 「该系统每 %d 回合自动触发一次」 drops 'can only' and makes it sound like a guaranteed periodic trigger, even though the heal only fires when no enemies are visible. It should say at most once every %d turns, e.g. 「该系统每 %d 回合最多触发一次」.
rows.conclusion: 宿主核对 avoidance.lua：resto_cd = t.getCD 为冷却上限，can only trigger once every %d turns 应为“最多一次”；与 surface 同条（行结构、制表符）合并修订。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: The source says 'Toxin strength scales with Steampower.' At tome-orcs/data/talents/steam/other.lua:1850, both the blight damage (t.getPower) and the global speed reduction (t.getPower-10) come from the same getPower. The target 「枯萎伤害受蒸汽强度加成」 limits the scaling to damage only and leaves out the speed reduction. Suggested fix: 「毒素强度受蒸汽强度加成」.
rows.conclusion: 宿主核对 other.lua:1829-1850：伤害与减速均取 getPower，Toxin strength 覆盖两者；与 surface 同条（制表符、as it is the ammo）合并修订。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 'this example' here means this particular item (the steamsaw artifact at world-artifacts.lua:1988-1991). Translating it literally as 「这个例子」 is wrong. The target also drops 'kitchen implement', and 'carcasses' means animal carcasses, not 「尸体」. Suggested fix: 「原本是巨人用来锯开坚硬冻肉的厨具。不过这一把透着格外邪恶的气息。」
rows.conclusion: 同 surface 裁决：Grinder（绞肉机）desc，kitchen implement、this example（这一把）、carcasses（兽尸）三处。 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

notes: All-Orcs batch: surface ran as four lanes of 20. Every lane echoed its identities exactly and the boundary scan passed without a manual audit. One lane-000-2 observation (gunslinger's trailing space) slid onto a later achievement entry; it was refuted there and the intended entry was checked and found correct.
The contextual run read only its own envelope, the contract and the Orcs source; no refreeze was needed.

Implementation-backed: the piloting buff really reduces cooldowns each turn, so the translation's added clause follows the code; the restoration system trigger is a cooldown cap, and Toxic Shell's steampower scaling covers both damage and slow.
Refuted: Subcutaneous Metallisation keeps its library name and 'a steamtech power' follows the talent-type label convention.
